blockers: Lamps 7-64 have no placement: the retained table draws every matrix lamp as an insert light with no bulb, and no lamp-location drawing was measured. A table that models the bulbs, or a measured factory drawing, would supply them.
Switches 12-15 and 36-40 and solenoids 11 and 12 have no defensible contact or coil geometry in the retained table; the reasons are listed per device.
Every placement is observed from one community table that is not known to have been played; none is checked against a factory drawing.
coordinate_convention: x 0 left / 1 right; y 0 rear / 1 apron, player view; VPX normalized by the table's own bounds with the shared six-decimal rounding

extraction_manifest.algorithm: tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py canonical sorted POSIX path/size/SHA256 entries, compact sorted-key JSON plus LF; exclude only manifest.json/manifest.sha256

Candidate geometry is listed in the spatial report.

unplaced_reasons.switch.lower-standup: The retained table models the 37-40 'standup' contacts as invisible shapeless Trigger strips along rubbers; sw38's strip is on the left side beside the upper half of the playfield, where Figure 3 also prints 38, although the chart calls it 'LOWER STANDUP'. unplaced_reasons.switch.outhole: Two table objects disagree and no callout was measured: the embedded script sets 12 from the hit handler of the bottom Drain kicker (650.2, 1950.1), while an invisible star Trigger named sw12 sits at the lower left (148.6, 1825.4). Figure 3 prints 12 at the lower left, which favours the trigger's side, but an unmeasured callout does not supply a coordinate.
